$comment: The scripts themselves are shared with Claude Code and live in scripts/hooks/;
only this wiring is Cursor-specific. See adapters/claude/settings.json for the
same three hooks in Claude Code's schema.
failClosed is false everywhere: a hook that wedges the session when pwsh is
missing would get switched off, and a guard nobody runs guards nothing.

preToolUse.$comment: Blocks destructive, hard-to-undo actions. The only hook here that prevents anything.

postToolUse.$comment: Keeps the tree formatted so verify's format phase does not fail on stale whitespace.
Reminds that the analyzer gates are pending. Throttled to once per 10 minutes per repo.
